mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_member (group_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS memberId, m.user_id AS userId, m.role AS role, CAST(m.album_permission AS UNSIGNED) AS albumPermission, DATE_FORMAT(m.joined_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS joinedAt, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM group_member m INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY (m.role = 'admin') DESC, m.joined_at ASC
SELECT * FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_member SET is_deleted = 1, left_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE group_member SET is_deleted = 1, left_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_deleted = 0
